spans.s:
m. (-क्षुः)
The sun.
E.
जगत् the universe, and चक्षुस् the eye.

mfn. (-गन्-गती-गत्)
Moveable, loco-motive, transitory.
nf. (-त्-ती)
The world, the universe.
m. (-त्)
Air, wind.
f. (-ती)
1 The earth.
2 People, mankind.
3 A sort of metre, a stanza of forty-eight syllables variously disposed so as to form thirty varieties.
4 A field of Jambu flowers.
E.
गम to go, Uṇādi affix अति, जग substituted for the root, and ङीप् fem. affix, or गम as before, and शतृ aff.

m. (-रः)
A mountain.
E.
जगती, and धर what holds.

m. (-तिः)
A king, a prince.
E.
जगती, and पति lord.

m. (-लः)
A king.
E.
जगती, and पाल who protects.

m. (-हः)
A tree.
E.
जगती, and रुह what grows.

m. (-र्त्ता)
A name of BRAHMĀ.
E.
जगत्, and कर्त्तृ a maker, the creator of the world.

n. (-लं)
The universe.
E.
जगत्, and कृत्स्न whole.

m. (-यः)
The destruction of the world.
E.
जगत्, and क्षय loss.

n. (-यं)
The three worlds, or heaven, earth, and hell.
E.
जगत्, and त्रय three.

m. (-तिः)
1 A king.
2 A deity.
E.
जगत्, and पति master.

m. (-णः)
Air, wind.
E.
जगत् the universe, and प्राण breath or being.

n. (-ग्रं)
The universe.
E.
जगत्, and समग्र whole.

n. (-र्व्वं)
The whole world.
E.
जगत्, and सर्व्व whole.

m. (-क्षी)
The sun.
E.
जगत् the universe, and साक्षिन, witness, spectator.

m. (-ष्टा)
The creator of the world, BRAHMĀ.
E.
जगत्, and स्रष्ट creator.

m. (-न्तः)
The end of the world.
E.
जगत्, and अन्त end.

f. (-म्बा)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
जगत्, and अम्बा mother.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Identical with the world.
E.
जगत्, and आत्मक same.

m. (-त्मा)
The supreme spirit.
E.
जगत्, and आत्मन् the soul.

m. (-रः)
1 Air, wind.
2 A stay or supporter of the universe.
E.
जगत् the world, and आधार support.

m. (-शः)
An epithet of VIṢṆU.
E.
जगत् the universe, and ईश lord.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Purifying or sanctifying the world.
E.
जगत्, एक chief, and पावन purifying.

f. (-री)
A name of MANASĀDEVĪ, the deified wife of the sage JARATKĀRU, and sister to the Nāgas or serpent race.
E.
जगत् the world, and गौरी the goddess GAURĪ; a terrestrial GAURĪ; her relationship to the snake breed is supposed to give her an influence over them, which is implored frequently by the Hindus.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
Destroying the world, destructive, hostile to mankind.
E.
जगत्, and घातिन् who destroys.

f. (-त्री)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
जगत्, and घात्री a nurse.

m. (-लः)
Air, wind.
E.
जगत् the universe, and वल surrounding.

m. (-निः)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2

A name of VIṢṆU.
f. (-निः)
The earth.
E.
जगत् the universe, and योनि womb, or place of production.

f. (-हा)
The earth.
E.
जगत् the universe, and वह what bears.

m. (-शः)
The expiration of a Yuga or period of the world's existence.
E.
जगत् the world, and विनाश destruction.

m. (-नुः)
1 Fire or its deity.
2 An animal or insect.
E.
गम to go, deriv. irr.

Fire.
2

An animal.
E.
जगत्, and नु to send, कु affix; also जगनु.

m. (-थः)
A form of VIṢṆU.
E.
जगत् the universe, and नाथ lord; a peculiar and celebrated idol of this name is worshipped on the Coromandel coast, in Orissa, and pilgrimages are made to the shrine of JAGANNĀTHA from all parts of India.

n. (-त्रं)
The shrine of JAGANNĀTHA and surrounding district.
E.
जगन्नाथ, and क्षेत्र holy place.

m. (-सः)
1 Worldly existence.
2 A deity, as VIṢṆU, in whom the world exists.
E.
जगत्, and निवास abode.

f. (-ता)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
जमत्, and मातृ mother.

mfn. (-वान्-नुषी-न्वत्)
Who or what goes.
E.
गम to go, वसु affix, root repeated.

m. (-रः)
Armour, mail.
E.
जागृ to awaken, अच् affix, deriv. irr.; also जागर.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Waking, awake.
mf. (-रः-रा)
Waking, wakefulness, vigilance, &c.
m. (-रः)
Mail, armour.
E.
जागृ to wake, affix अप्.

m. (-लः)
1 Vinous liquor for distilling.
2 Armour: see the preceding.
E.
गल to ooze, अच् affix, and the root reduplicated; otherwise ल interchanged with रः see जगर.

mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं)
Eaten.
n. (-ग्धं)
Food.
E.
अद to eat, affix क्त, and जग्ध substituted for the regular form.

Eating.
2

Eating, together or in company.
3 Food, victuals.
E.
अद to eat, क्तिन् affix, and जग्धि substituted.

m. (-ग्मिः)
Air, wind.
E.
गम to go, कि affix, root reiterated, and form irr.

mfn. (-वान्-ग्मुषी-वत्)
Who or what goes.
E.
गम to go, वसु affix, इट् inserted.

n. (-णं)
1 Waking, watchfulness.
2 Keeping watch, sitting up at night as part of a religious ceremony.
E.
जागृ to be awake, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Wakeful, awake, vigilant.
E.
जागृ to wake, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Wakeful, awake.
E.
जागृ to wake, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Wakeful, waking, watchful.
E.
जागृ to wake, ऊक aff.

f. (-र्त्तिः)
1 Waking, vigilance.
2 Keeping watch.
E.
जागृ to wake, क्तिच् aff.

f. (-र्य्या)
Wakefulness, waking, watching.
E.
जागृ as above, यक् aff.

n. (-डं)
Saffron.

r. 2nd cl. (जागर्त्ति)
To wake, to be awake or watchful.

m. (-विः)
Fire or its deity.
E.
जागृ to wake, Uṇādi affix क्विन्.

mfn. (-ग्रन्-ग्रती-ग्रत्)
Watching, being awake.
E.
जागृ to wake, Uṇādi affix शतृ.

f. (-या)
Waking, watching.
E.
जागृ to wake, यत् affix, ऋ changed to its congener रि.
